primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
